_comment: Per-view blocks. {VIEW_NOTES} comes from config fourview.view_notes.<view>. Tripo web slot names are Front / Left / Right / Back - upload by NAME, not by order.
front:
VIEW: FRONT view (0 degrees): the character faces the camera squarely. {VIEW_NOTES} Hands empty.

ATTACHED REFERENCES (use each ONLY for the stated purpose):
- Image 1 (approved design sheet of {NAME}): identity, face, hair, clothing, colours and props. IGNORE its pose, anything held in the hands, its expression, its illustration proportions, its floor shadow and any glow spill.
- Image 2 (the approved model-sheet front view of a DIFFERENT character): use it ONLY as the template for head-to-body ratio, A-pose, arm angle, framing, flat grey background, soft shadowless light and the painted-texture treatment. Take NOTHING of that character's design: not hair, face, clothes, props or colours. {NAME} must be drawn in exactly this format but as themself.
left:
VIEW: LEFT view (rotated exactly 90 degrees): a true 90-degree side profile showing the character's OWN LEFT SIDE to the camera. The face, nose and boot toes point to the IMAGE LEFT edge. Only the left ear and one eye in profile are visible. Legs overlap into one leg silhouette, arms into one arm silhouette hanging alongside the body. {VIEW_NOTES} FACING CHECK: face in the left half of the head silhouette, toes point left (drawing it facing right is wrong and mirrors the 3D model).

ATTACHED REFERENCES (use each ONLY for the stated purpose):
- Image 1 (the approved FRONT view of {NAME}): this is the character, rotated 90 degrees. Keep IDENTICAL head size and head-to-body ratio, figure height, framing, A-pose, face, hair colours, every item of clothing and gear, the flat grey background, the soft light and the painted-texture treatment.
- Image 2 (design sheet): use ONLY for the design of clothing and gear seen from the side; ignore its pose, held items, expression, proportions, shadow and glow spill.
right:
VIEW: RIGHT view (rotated exactly 90 degrees the other way): a true 90-degree side profile showing the character's OWN RIGHT SIDE to the camera. The face, nose and boot toes point to the IMAGE RIGHT edge. Only the right ear and one eye in profile are visible. Legs overlap into one leg silhouette, arms into one arm silhouette. {VIEW_NOTES} FACING CHECK: face in the right half of the head silhouette, toes point right.

ATTACHED REFERENCES (use each ONLY for the stated purpose):
- Image 1 (the approved FRONT view of {NAME}): this is the character, rotated 90 degrees. Keep IDENTICAL head size and ratio, figure height, framing, A-pose, face, hair colours, clothing and gear, background, light and painted texture.
- Image 2 (design sheet): use ONLY for the design of clothing and gear seen from the side; ignore its pose, held items, expression, proportions, shadow and glow spill.
back:
VIEW: BACK view (180 degrees): the character seen squarely from behind. NO part of the face is visible. Left and right are mirrored compared with the front view: the character's own left side is now on the IMAGE LEFT. {VIEW_NOTES}

ATTACHED REFERENCES (use each ONLY for the stated purpose):
- Image 1 (the approved FRONT view of {NAME}): this is the character, rotated 180 degrees. Keep IDENTICAL head size and ratio, figure height, framing, A-pose, hair, clothing and gear, background, light and painted texture.
- Image 2 (design sheet): use ONLY for the design of clothing and gear seen from behind.
- Image 3 (top-down game-camera drawing, if attached): use ONLY to understand the back of the gear/backpack; ignore its pose, camera angle, ground shadow and glow.
